Guidance & outlook: Distribution today is no longer limited to physical movement of products; it increasingly requires data-led decision- making, platform integration, digital visibility and agile fulfilment capabilities.

That is why we provide targeted training programmes, interactive workshops and leadership development opportunities, equipping our employees with future-ready capabilities to adapt to evolving technologies, business models and customer expectations.
The market reached approximately USD 129.72 Billion in 2025 and is expected to continue growing at a robust pace over the medium term.
Growth & demand: Flagship Product Highlights - Saregama Carvaan Particulars Details Launch Year 2017 Music Library 5,000+ pre-loaded songs Languages Multi-language curated collections Connectivity Bluetooth-enabled Additional Features FM/AM Radio, Built-in Stereo Speakers 2.

ECONOMIC OVERVIEW In 2025, the global economy grew by 3.4% 1, reflecting moderate but resilient expansion amid trade policy recalibrations, easing inflationary pressures and improving supply chain efficiencies.
India's GDP grew by 7.7% 3 during 2025-26, supported by resilient domestic demand, sustained infrastructure investments and continued strength in the services sector.
Margins & costs: The pricing of goods shall be determined having regard to prevailing market prices, comparable third-party distributor pricing, volume-based commercial arrangements, logistics costs, credit terms and other customary commercial considerations.
Cost Auditors The Company is not required to maintain cost records as prescribed by Central Government under Section 148(1) of the Companies Act, 2013.
The Net Profit Margin increased by 28.17%, from 18.85% to 24.16%, mainly due to improved operational performance and higher profitability during the year.
Capex & expansion: The rapid expansion of internet access, digital payments and technology-enabled retail has fundamentally altered how consumers discover, evaluate and purchase products.
Our continued investment in digital technology, automation and intelligent platforms is strengthening operational agility, improving scalability and enhancing service reliability.

Future Outlook Looking ahead, we will continue investing in intelligent technologies, automation and advanced analytics to strengthen speed, scalability and operational resilience across our digital distribution ecosystem.
Balance sheet & cash: Consolidated net profit for the year stood at Rs.5.38 Cr, despite evolving market dynamics and transitional challenges across segments of the retail ecosystem, the Company maintained healthy profitability and a debt- free balance sheet, reinforcing our commitment to prudent capital management and long-term value creation.

DIVIDEND With a view to conserving resources to support the Company's business requirements, strategic initiatives and future growth opportunities, the Board of Directors has not recommended any dividend for the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026.
During Financial Year 2025-26, the Current Ratio increased by 29.38%, from 4.80 times to 6.21 times, primarily on account of improved working capital management and a stronger liquidity position.
Risks & challenges: The Risk Management Committee assists the Board in overseeing the Company's risk management framework and ensuring that material risks, including strategic, commercial, cybersecurity, operational, compliance, control, and financial risks, are appropriately identified and managed through effective mitigation measures.
Competition Risk Digidrive operates in a highly competitive environment characterised by digital disruption, platform-led competition and rapidly evolving consumer preferences.

REPORT ON CORPORATE GOVERNANCE (Contd.) Digidrive Distributors Limited Annual Report - 2025-26 COMMODITY PRICE RISK, FOREIGN EXCHANGE RISK, AND HEDGING ACTIVITIES The Company did not encounter any commodity price risks or foreign exchange risks, nor did it engage in any hedging activities during the year.
